data: Considering the color scale in Figure 5, which cell in the confusion matrix shows the highest value?

The color scale on the right side of the figure indicates values ranging from 0.0 to 0.8. The cells in the confusion matrix are colored based on these values. The cell with the highest value is the one with the lightest color, which corresponds to the highest value on the color scale. In this case, the cell with the value 199 is the darkest yellow, indicating the highest value. Therefore, the cell showing the highest value is the one at the intersection of TIN (True label) and TIN (Predicted label).
